memories.author: D05
memories.text: Asthma, not well controlled. Patient reports daytime cough twice weekly, nighttime awakenings once, occasional wheeze on exertion. Exam: mild expiratory wheeze bilaterally, normal spirometry shows FEV1 2.20 L (68% pred), FVC 2.80 L (85% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.79. Hypothyroidism stable on levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, TSH 4.2 mIU/L. ACT score 16.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS; Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler 2 puffs BD; Montelukast 10 mg HS; Levothyroxine 50 mcg OD.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chest X-ray PA: lungs clear, no infiltrates, cardiac silhouette normal.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-06-10 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Allergy: Penicillin - rash and pruritus within 30 minutes of ingestion.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: 'I’ve been using my salbutamol inhaler about 3-4 times a week, feels okay but I still get tight chest when climbing stairs.'

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Asthma, partly controlled. Patient reports daytime symptoms 2-3 days/week, nighttime awakenings 0-1/week, uses SABA 3 times/week. Exam: occasional wheeze at bases. Spirometry: FEV1 2.45 L (76% pred, +0.25 L since last), FVC 2.95 L (90% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.83. ACT score 19 (borderline). Hypothyroidism: TSH 3.8 mIU/L.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS; Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler 2 puffs BD; Montelukast 10 mg HS; Levothyroxine 75 mcg OD.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Refer to Endocrinology for optimisation of levothyroxine dosage and review of subclinical hypothyroidism.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Endocrinology letter: Patient euthyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD, TSH 3.6. Continue same dose, repeat TSH in 6 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Asthma, well controlled. Patient reports daytime symptoms ≤2 days/week, no night awakenings, SABA use ≤2 times/week. Exam: clear lungs. Spirometry: FEV1 2.70 L (84% pred, +0.25 L since last), FVC 3.10 L (95% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.87. ACT score 22. Hypothyroidism stable on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS; Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler 2 puffs BD; Montelukast 10 mg HS; Levothyroxine 75 mcg OD.
